lookback_source.quote: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

lookback_notes: The item's own Steps for Assessment state a 7-day look-back period, tied to the wandering behaviors identified in E0900. Per the general convention (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21), the ARD is day 1 counting back, i.e., ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days.

coding_levels.label: No (E1000A: significant risk of getting to a potentially dangerous place)
coding_levels.definition: Code 0, no: if wandering does not place the resident at significant risk.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if wandering does not place the resident at significant risk.

coding_levels.label: Yes (E1000A: significant risk of getting to a potentially dangerous place)
coding_levels.definition: Code 1, yes: if the wandering places the resident at significant risk of getting to a dangerous place (e.g., wandering outside the facility where there is heavy traffic) or encountering a dangerous situation (e.g., wandering into the room of another resident with dementia who is known to become physically aggressive toward intruders).

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if the wandering places the resident at significant risk of getting to a dangerous place (e.g., wandering outside the facility where there is heavy traffic) or encountering a dangerous situation (e.g., wandering into the room of another resident with dementia who is known to become physically aggressive toward intruders).

coding_levels.label: No (E1000B: significantly intrude on the privacy or activities of others)
coding_levels.definition: Code 0, no: if the wandering does not intrude on the privacy or activity of others.

source.quote: Code 0, no: if the wandering does not intrude on the privacy or activity of others.

coding_levels.label: Yes (E1000B: significantly intrude on the privacy or activities of others)
coding_levels.definition: Code 1, yes: if the wandering intrudes on the privacy or activities of others (i.e., if the wandering violates other residents' privacy or interrupts other residents' performance of activities of daily living or limits engagement in or enjoyment of social or recreational activities), whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

source.quote: Code 1, yes: if the wandering intrudes on the privacy or activities of others (i.e., if the wandering violates other residents’ privacy or interrupts other residents’ performance of activities of daily living or limits engagement in or enjoyment of social or recreational activities), whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Complete E1000 only if E0900 (Wandering—Presence & Frequency) was coded 1, 2, or 3.

source.quote: Answer this item only if E0900, Wandering—Presence & Frequency, was coded 1 (behavior of this type occurred 1-3 days), 2 (behavior of this type occurred 4-6 days, but less than daily), or 3 (behavior of this type occurred daily).

federal_coding_rules.rule: If E0900 is coded 0 (behavior not exhibited), skip to E1100, Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms (E1000 is not completed).

source.quote: Code 0, behavior not exhibited: if wandering was not exhibited during the 7-day look-back period. Skip to Change in Behavior or Other Symptoms item (E1100).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Determine whether wandering behaviors put the resident at significant risk of getting into potentially dangerous places and/or significantly intrude on the privacy or activities of others, based on clinical judgment for the individual resident.

source.quote: Determine whether those behaviors put the resident at significant risk of getting into potentially dangerous places and/or whether wandering significantly intrudes on the privacy or activities of others based on clinical judgment for the individual resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code E1000B as 1, yes, whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

source.quote: whether or not the other resident complains or communicates displeasure or annoyance.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Moving about with the use of a wheelchair meets the definition of wandering for purposes of coding E1000 impact.

source.quote: Moving about in this manner with the use of a wheelchair meets the definition of wandering, and the resident has intruded on the privacy of another resident and has interfered with that resident’s ability to use the bathroom.

federal.criterion: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

source.quote: Consider the previous review of the resident's wandering behaviors identified in E0900 for the 7-day look-back period.

federal.notes: Step 1 of Steps for Assessment; the E0900 review is based on medical record review and staff interview (p. E-19).

case_mix_relevance.notes: The pages for E1000 do not tie the item to any payment or case-mix classification.
